name: ibis Styles Jakarta Airport
short_description: A 251-room economy hotel about 2 km (10 minutes) from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, with a complimentary airport shuttle, all-you-can-eat breakfast for two, a pool, and 7 meeting rooms.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Jakarta Airport is a 251-room economy hotel in Kampung Rawa Bokor, Tangerang, about 2 km (roughly a 10-minute drive) from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK), making it a common pick for early-morning departures and transit stays. The hotel leans on the ibis Styles brand's colorful, design-forward look and offers a complimentary airport shuttle, all-you-can-eat buffet breakfast for two included in the room rate, an outdoor swimming pool, a wellness and spa center, gym, and 7 meeting rooms. Guest reviews are mixed-to-positive: many praise the friendly staff, clean rooms, and shuttle convenience, and breakfast starting around 4am is repeatedly called out as useful for early flights, but a recurring complaint is that the shuttle's fixed schedule and multiple CGK terminals mean it isn't always reliable for time-pressed travelers, and at least one long-time guest noted the breakfast selection has narrowed over the years.

research_highlights: TripAdvisor ranks the hotel around #43 of roughly 92 hotels in Tangerang with a 4/5 rating; Booking.com shows about 1,446 reviews at 7.9/10
251 rooms with the ibis bedding concept, free WiFi, and a complimentary roundtrip airport shuttle

research_watchouts: Reviewers repeatedly flag the shuttle as less convenient than advertised: fixed timetable, three CGK terminals, and at least one reviewer calling airport pick-up unreliable

A June 2026 Trip.com review from a Diamond-tier guest reported poor smoking-room ventilation and an unprofessional front-desk experience over a late-checkout charge -- an outlier versus the generally positive review base

faqs.question: How far is ibis Styles Jakarta Airport from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about 2 km away, roughly a 10-minute drive, and offers a complimentary shuttle -- though guests note CGK's three terminals and the shuttle's fixed schedule mean it's worth confirming timing in advance for early or tight-connection flights.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included at ibis Styles Jakarta Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes -- room rates include an all-you-can-eat buffet breakfast for two guests, with service starting around 4am to accommodate early-morning flights out of nearby Soekarno-Hatta International Airport. Guests consistently call this out as a useful value-add versus other budget airport hotels, though at least one long-time visitor has noted the breakfast selection has narrowed somewhat over recent years.
